profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Meta | AI Infrastructure & Distributed Systems
profile.summary:
Software Engineer at Meta focused on ads infrastructure and distributed systems. I build and own backend systems that operate at massive scale from privacy compliance tooling that protects user data across millions of accounts, to ads signals infrastructure that drives tens of millions in incremental revenue.

Before Meta, I built JPMorgan Chase's customer-facing privacy compliance platform and co-founded Sponges, an on-demand marketplace that scaled to $500K ARR.

I'm passionate about systems that are fast, reliable, and built to last.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and launched new ads signals across Meta's Family of Apps (Facebook, Instagram), driving ~13.9B annual ad impressions and ~$64M in incremental annualized ads revenue.

- Created an automated data pipeline that identified ads signals incorrectly blocked by privacy restrictions, recovering ~$19M in incremental annualized ads revenue while maintaining regulatory compliance.

- Developed core components of Weaver, an ads infra platform that tracks upstream data sources for ads signals, collaborating with four privacy infra teams to unblock their privacy reviews and save 16,000 engineering hours.

- Drove and authored a technical proposal for new ads signals, securing cross-team alignment, with an estimated ~$15M in incremental annualized ads revenue impact.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Rebuilt the customer-facing privacy compliance interface in React.js to support CCPA & CPRA compliance, replacing a legacy frontend framework and improving development velocity and maintainability.

- Migrated backend privacy services off a legacy system onto AWS, improving development productivity and scalability.

positions.title: Founding Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built a B2C on-demand vehicle services marketplace, scaling from $0 to $500K ARR with ~6,000 users.

- Developed core platform features including booking flows, scheduling, service dispatch using NextJs, React, Postgresql, NodeJS and AWS.

- Integrated third-party services like Stripe and Twilio for payments, customer messaging, and geolocation.
